schedule.schedule_tag: w4t1 (frozen primary schedule; P05S chose it as primary from live-memory screens)

cache_policy.cold_stores: fresh outdir per run, asserted non-existent before the call
cache_policy.warmup: one UNTIMED run per arm before any measured window (per-tree warm JIT, per BENCHMARKS.md regime 1)
cache_policy.existing_graph_cache: identically cold both arms (no cache-off asymmetry)

output_policy.bitwise_law: 64/64 sha256 equality vs the frozen P00 pin OUTSIDE timing on EVERY measured window, both arms
output_policy.state_duty: batch report, output manifest, ordered commits, zero failed rows, engagement asserts green (cand) / no-cohort (base)

timer_law: wall brackets ONLY the public UNA.RunBatch call, through successful completion (required files, state, checkpoint/publication guarantees); bitwise verification OUTSIDE timing; import/JIT/pool overhead recorded separately; proc-start-to-done reported as the cold boundary
equal_budget_law: same host, same C=4 physical cores, same fresh-process protocol per run, cold stores both arms, per-tree warm numba caches; neither arm gets off-clock preparation the public call would do

windows.pair: base arm then cand arm (or reversed per alternation); same 32-job cohort manifest bytes each run
windows.no_optional_stopping: all seven windows run once each; no reruns, no early stop, no window replacement
windows.invalidation: any window with a bitwise mismatch, failed row, engagement-assert failure or cold-store violation INVALIDATES the gate (abort, no silent replacement)

decision.reported: exp(median); one-sided 95% lower bound = exp(0.05 quantile of 20000 bootstrap resampled medians, seed 20261003)
decision.possible_outcomes: observed_cohort_10x OR target_unmet (improvement_only wording if useful scoped changes remain)
